sourceSummary.zh: 李录从商业文明与资本市场谈起，把全球投资的目标落到购买力，再用企业所有权、安全边际、能力圈和具体问答解释如何行动。
sourceSummary.en: Li Lu connects commercial civilization and capital markets with purchasing power, then develops ownership, margin of safety and competence into a practical approach.

heading.zh: 宏观越难判断，研究应落在哪里
heading.en: Where research belongs amid macro uncertainty

paragraphs.zh: 演讲先花了相当篇幅讨论经济与资本市场，随后把问题转向投资者自己：即使对一家企业做过充分研究，宏观环境令人困惑时，还能否坚定持有？李录关心的是，怎样在不能左右的大环境中找到可以理解和判断的对象。现代资本市场在他的论证中承担连接储蓄、创新企业与长期资金的作用，制度、信用和信任共同构成这座桥梁。
paragraphs.en: After discussing economics and capital markets, Li Lu turns to the investor: can someone retain confidence in a thoroughly researched company when the macro environment is confusing? His question concerns finding understandable, assessable opportunities within conditions one cannot control. In his account, modern capital markets connect savings with innovative businesses and long-term capital through institutions, credibility and accumulated trust.

heading.en: Purchasing power as the measure of wealth

paragraphs.zh: 他把财富定义为一个人在经济中所占的购买力，而不是账户上的名义金额。由此，选择资产还要联系将来在哪里消费、需要购买什么。演讲中对全球投资的讨论也从这里展开：寻找有活力的经济体及其中有创造力、竞争力的企业，同时考虑自己的实际消费需求。这让“全球配置”有了明确目的——长期保有并增加真实的消费能力。
paragraphs.en: He defines wealth through purchasing power within an economy rather than the nominal balance of an account. Asset selection therefore relates to where and how someone expects to consume. His discussion of global investing follows from this: seek dynamic economies and creative, competitive businesses while considering actual consumption needs. Global allocation serves the concrete purpose of preserving and increasing real spending capacity.

heading.zh: 从便宜的证券走向优秀且便宜的企业
heading.en: From cheap securities to quality at a discount

paragraphs.zh: 回顾早期投资时，李录说自己最初寻找便宜公司，随后逐步建立能力圈，转向研究既优秀又便宜的公司。巴菲特和芒格带来的进一步认识，是长期回报可以来自优秀企业不断创造的新价值。导读的理解是：这里包含两种相互连接的收益来源——买入时已有的价值折让，以及持有期间企业继续积累的价值；企业质量决定后者有没有持续发展的基础。
paragraphs.en: Looking back, Li Lu describes starting with cheap companies and gradually developing the competence to identify quality businesses at attractive prices. Buffett and Munger added an emphasis on new value created by exceptional businesses over time. The guide reads this as connecting two sources of return: an initial discount to existing value and the value accumulated during ownership. Business quality underpins the second.

heading.zh: 所有权、市场先生与安全边际怎样相连
heading.en: Connecting ownership, Mr. Market and margin of safety

paragraphs.zh: 股票代表企业的一部分所有权，市场提供交易价格，安全边际则约束愿意支付的价格。这几个原则在演讲里是相互衔接的：先研究企业价值，才有依据判断报价是否有吸引力；把报价当成可选择的交易条件，才有可能在市场情绪极端时独立行动。李录也把长期低迷中的机会与企业基本面联系起来，重点在于企业价值与价格之间的距离。
paragraphs.en: Ownership, quoted prices and margin of safety form a connected argument. Understanding business value provides a basis for assessing whether a quote is attractive. Treating that quote as an optional trading condition makes independent action possible when sentiment becomes extreme. Li Lu connects opportunities during prolonged market weakness with business fundamentals and the gap between value and price.

heading.zh: 钓鱼的故事：能力圈要落实成优势
heading.en: The fishing story makes competence concrete

paragraphs.zh: 演讲借钓鱼的故事解释能力圈：真正的优势来自知道哪里有鱼、掌握合适的方法，并选择竞争较少的地方。把这个比喻放回投资，研究对象不需要覆盖整个世界；重要的是对某些企业形成足够深入、能够检验的认识。导读的理解是，能力圈在这里包含知识、研究方法和机会选择，三者一起决定一个人在哪些问题上能够作出更好的判断。
paragraphs.en: The fishing story makes advantage tangible: know where fish are, use suitable methods, and find less crowded locations. Applied to investing, research need not encompass the whole world. What matters is developing deep, testable understanding of particular businesses. The guide interprets competence here as a combination of knowledge, research methods and opportunity selection that improves judgment in identifiable areas.

heading.zh: 长期持有也有明确的卖出条件
heading.en: Long-term ownership has explicit selling conditions

paragraphs.zh: 在问答中，李录列出了卖出的几类考虑：发现判断有误，遇到风险收益关系更好的机会，以及市场出现极端泡沫估值。他接着提醒，企业的长期成长往往容易被短期因素遮住。把这两层意思放在一起，才能理解他的耐心：持有建立在持续研究和机会比较之上；错误、机会成本与极端价格，仍然需要作出判断。
paragraphs.en: In the Q&A, Li Lu identifies selling considerations including recognizing a mistake, finding an opportunity with a better risk-reward relationship, and extreme bubble valuations. He also observes that short-term factors can obscure long-term business growth. Together these points explain his patience as continued research and comparison, while still requiring judgment about errors, opportunity costs and exceptional prices.
